protocol.isolation: Builds, tests, profiles and timed benchmarks run serially. Independent source review may overlap.
protocol.diagnostics: A separate instrumented branch records per-compilation table occupancy, value size, lookup/default frequencies and MergeInputs lookups. Run original official Compiler callbacks once and the unchanged DataView suite; these diagnostics are not performance measurements.
protocol.candidates: Choose indexed/chunked storage from measured density. Test storage and MergeInputs caching independently from c281a2f9; do not stack unmeasured candidates.
protocol.cost: Each correctness-validated candidate gets six fixed alternating DataView compilation-cost pairs, including every round.
protocol.compiler: Each correctness-validated candidate gets twelve fixed alternating official Compiler pairs regardless of cost-diagnostic outcome; report all nine cases and AB/BA splits.
protocol.runtime: Each retained candidate gets twenty-one fixed stock DataView pairs.
protocol.statistics: One warmup per binary, fresh processes, paired bootstrap with 10000 resamples and seed 20261021. Per-case intervals are not corrected for multiple comparisons.
protocol.checkpoints: Unsigned source and evidence commits for every experiment, including diagnostics and rejected candidates. Preserve original binaries and all measured rounds.
protocol.upstream_validation: After the bounded escape-analysis round, apply the existing fresh-allocation lookup patch alone on pristine 293377af. Validate correctness and collect twelve fixed official Compiler pairs and twenty-one stock DataView pairs against the preserved pristine build. No upload or publication.

limits: Hardware perf remains unavailable (perf_event_paranoid=4). Use the native sampler, phase statistics, counters and disassembly. Sample shares are not promised gains. Preserve default/reference semantics, traversal, safepoints, allocation budgets and generated-program behavior.
